searchText: CL call in 9.5 hours https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/475 although stake remains decentralized, doesn't this still threaten chain liveness? if all blocks are created by a few centralized builders, if any of those go down it would have a big impact on proposed blocks, as proposing validators cannot fall back on building a block themselves anymore. Unless I'm missing something... hmm, interesting. I was thinking about unintended failure (builder downtime) rather than malicious censorship but some of the solutions could overlap, like auxiliary builders. Going to take a closer look later. Still won't fix degenerate cases I guess, like having only 3 mega block builders in existence, all on AWS suffering an outage Quick call notes: https://hackmd.io/@benjaminion/S1YGF9Gk9 <@!360491619402776577> ^^^ Thanks ❤️ Exactly what I was looking for!
